newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Credit Bk says preparing for MOF inspection.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Credit Bk says preparing for MOF inspection.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd said on Monday that the bank has been preparing for a regular inspection by the Ministry of Finance.
The ministry's previous inspection was conducted in August 1993.
Japanese newspapers reported over the weekend that MOF would conduct its inspection this week in order to clarify the situation of the bank's asset and problem loans.
The inspection will help NCB win an agreement from financial institutions which have been asked to buy new shares to be issued by Nippon Credit to help boost its capital, the newspapers said.

On April 1, NCB announced a restructuring programme supported by the Finance Ministry, under which it said it would aggressively write off problem loans and retreat from overseas operations. It also said that it was selling prime real estate and floating new shares to try to rebuild its capital base.

NCB announced last week that it intends to increase its capital by 290.7 billion yen by issuing ordinary and preferred shares, but financial sources said that private-sector financial institutions have been reluctant to buy.
